Interface Species

All Known Implementing Classes:
AttaCephalotes, Camponotus, CamponotusPennsylvanicus, CustomSpecies, FormicaRufa, LasiusNiger, LinepithemaHumile, SmartAntSpecies, SolenopsisInvicta
public interface Species
Interface for species definitions. Each species defines physical characteristics, lifecycle, and behavior parameters.
